items.coder_A: uncertain: only candidate is nivolumab (not a registered intervention)
items.proposed: Agreed coding stands: has_eligible_candidate true, nivolumab candidate
items.reason: Nivolumab is named in every arm label ('Cohort 2: Multiple dose of EO2041 in combination with nivolumab') and in the intervention text ('coadministered with or without nivolumab'); Cohort 1 also continues with nivolumab, so every patient receives it and it is listed under R9. Per the 'Pembrolizumab + an investigational vaccine' worked example it is the candidate; EO2401 vaccine is excluded type.
Only non-excluded investigational agent in the experimental cohorts; title 'With and Without Check Point Inhibitor' makes the checkpoint inhibitor part of the investigational question.
Same content, naming only; EO2401 (vaccine) and bevacizumab (Cohort 3, 'US only') are the antitumour partners of nivolumab. regimen 'combination' agreed.

The only biomarker endpoint is vaccine immunogenicity ('proof of CD8 T cells specific for the EO2401 mimic peptides'), which is not linked to the candidate nivolumab or its target; W7 says such an unlinked biomarker endpoint is 'unclear', not 'no'. XL may prefer 'no' since the endpoint is clearly the vaccine's.

note: Nivolumab is not a registered intervention; candidate status rests on R9 (every patient receives it per arm labels). Bevacizumab (Cohort 3, US only) agreed non-candidate (A soc_backbone, B established_therapy_experiment; priority-3 item, not adjudicated here). HLA-A2 is germline, not a tumour biomarker.
